name: record_id
description: UUID assigned at validation time. Primary key for the staged record.

name: has_diagnosed_learning_difficulty
description: DCYN field. Collapses the free-text intake question into a strict Yes/No.

name: diagnosis_type
description: Populated only when has_diagnosed_learning_difficulty is true; enforced at the serializer level, not left to human review.

name: guardian_consent_given
description: DCYN field. Must be true for the record to be promoted from D0 to D1 at all.

name: requires_lsa_support
description: DCYN field. Drives whether the record is routed to LSA matching.

name: preferred_session_frequency
description: One of a fixed enum (daily/weekly/biweekly/monthly) — never free text.

name: contact_email
description: Guardian contact email, format-validated before promotion.

name: submitted_at
description: Validation timestamp, set server-side — never trusted from the incoming payload.
